I am a Systems Analyst and Backend Developer focused on designing and building scalable, maintainable, and secure backend systems.

My expertise includes developing both **service-oriented monolithic applications** and **microservices architectures** using **Java with Spring Boot** and **TypeScript with NestJS**. I have experience designing modular systems, implementing clean architecture principles, integrating relational databases, identity providers, messaging platforms, and event-driven workflows.

I work with technologies such as PostgreSQL, PostGIS, Oracle Database, Redis, MQTT brokers, and authentication and authorization solutions, always prioritizing maintainability, scalability, and long-term system evolution.

Currently, I am expanding my expertise in **AWS Cloud Services**, **CI/CD automation with GitHub Actions**, and **SaaS deployment strategies**.
